summary: Unidentified caller asked why a salary certificate from August was rejected; assistant explained the 30-day rule (previously 90), that age is measured on the submission date, and that both employed spouses need one.

transcript.text: مرحباً بك في هيئة مرسى النور للتطوير، معك المساعد الافتراضي. Welcome to MNDA, how can I help?

وعليكم السلام. I can explain the general rule without opening your file. Under Circular 9/2026, section 4.4, for applications submitted from 1 September 2026 the salary certificate must be issued within the 30 days before you submit — previously it was 90 days. A certificate older than 30 days on the submission date is treated as missing (section 6.1).

Yes — if both spouses are employed, both salary certificates are required, each issued within the last 30 days and showing basic salary and total allowances.
